class.name: DisRecorder
class.brief_description: Records the datagrams of a DisNetwork to a pcapng or pdulog file.
class.description: Writes every datagram that a [DisNetwork] receives, and with [member record_sent] every datagram it sends, to a file while the game runs. Datagrams are recorded before the network's filters, so other exercises and malformed packets are recorded too (readers skip what is not DIS). Packets injected with [method DisNetwork.inject_packet] are not recorded. The format is [code]pcapng[/code] (readable by Wireshark) or [code]pdulog[/code] (plain text, one datagram per line), chosen by [member format]; with automatic format the file name decides: [code].pdulog[/code] gives pdulog, anything else pcapng. The file is written as it goes and flushed every [member flush_interval] seconds, so a crash loses at most that much. Own PDUs that come back through broadcast or multicast loopback are recorded once: as sent when [member record_sent] is on, as received otherwise. Files are opened with [FileAccess], so [code]user://[/code] paths work; missing folders are created. The recorder finds its network through the group [code]dis_network[/code] unless [member network_path] is set. Recording stops when the node leaves the tree. Nothing runs in the editor. [codeblock] var recorder := DisRecorder.new() add_child(recorder) recorder.start("user://exercise.pcapng") # ... recorder.stop() [/codeblock]

method.name: get_elapsed
method.description: Returns the seconds since [method start] while recording, otherwise [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: get_packet_count
method.description: Returns the number of datagrams written since the last [method start].

method.name: get_recording_path
method.description: Returns the path of the current or last recording.

method.name: is_recording
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while a file is open for recording.

method.name: start
method.description: Starts writing to [param file_path], or to [member path] if it is empty. A running recording is stopped first. Returns [constant @GlobalScope.ERR_UNCONFIGURED] if there is no [DisNetwork] in the scene, the file error if the file cannot be opened, otherwise [constant @GlobalScope.OK]. Emits [signal started].

method.name: stop
method.description: Flushes and closes the file and stops listening to the network. Emits [signal stopped]. Does nothing if not recording.

members.member: If [code]true[/code], recording starts to [member path] shortly after the node is ready (deferred, so that a [DisNetwork] later in the tree has opened its socket).
Time in seconds between writes to disk. Data is also written whenever 256 KiB have accumulated.
File format, as a value of [enum DisRecording.Format]: 0 chooses by the file name extension (automatic), 1 is pcapng, 2 is pdulog.
Path to the [DisNetwork] to record. If empty, the first node in the group [code]dis_network[/code] is used.
File that [method start] writes to when called without a path. A [code]user://[/code] path is typical.

If [code]true[/code], datagrams this application sends are recorded too, with this computer's first routable IPv4 address as source. If [code]false[/code], only received datagrams (including the echo of our own broadcast or multicast) are recorded.

signal.name: started
signal.description: Emitted when recording has started. [param path] is the file being written.

signal.name: stopped
signal.description: Emitted when recording has stopped (not when the node is being freed). [param path] is the file that was written and [param packet_count] the number of datagrams in it.
